about: fork-fleet-walls.test.py: `pass` is a fake WSL2 distro on which every wall of `wsl2` holds (paths under FORK_FLEET_WALLS_ROOT; a string is a file's text, a path ending in / a folder, {"text", "mode"} a file with that mode; opt/fork-fleet/fork-fleet-launch.sh a launcher with the job units' walls). Windows' drive is mounted at /mnt/c and /c, WSL's shares and sockets at /mnt/wsl, /mnt/wslg, /usr/lib/wsl/drivers and /tmp/.X11-unix: all outside the launcher's allow list, so they hold. `fail` names each wall with the changes that make it fail (null removes a path).

pass.opt/fork-fleet/fork-fleet-launch.sh:
#!/bin/bash
# -p RestrictAddressFamilies=~AF_VSOCK in a comment is not a property
sandbox() {
  local user=$1 resolv=$2 own=$3
  local -a props_fs
  job_fs "$4" "$5"
  props=(
    -p "NetworkNamespacePath=/run/netns/fork-fleet-$user"
    "${props_fs[@]}"
    -p "TemporaryFileSystem=/run /dev/shm:size=1G,mode=1777 /tmp:size=1G,mode=1777 /var/tmp:size=1G,mode=1777"
    -p "BindReadOnlyPaths=$RESOLV_CONF:$resolv"
    -p NoNewPrivileges=yes -p ProtectSystem=strict
    -p RestrictAddressFamilies=~AF_VSOCK
    -p "SystemCallFilter=~io_uring_setup:ENOSYS io_uring_enter:ENOSYS io_uring_register:ENOSYS"
    -p SystemCallArchitectures=native
  )
}
